# PnL {#sec-pnl}

*This section covers* the bottom line — wrapping a complete engine in a profit
model. Two views of the same economics:

- **@sec-pnl-consolidated** — the `pnl`: one consolidated net group
  (consideration / obligation / margin), the summary card.
- **@sec-pnl-walk** — the `xpnl`: the step-by-step walk gross → each cession →
  Total, showing how the consolidated view is built.

Both inherit premium from the wrapped book and read scenario (κ) columns beside
the marginal (P) percentiles.
